Are you passionate about customer service, coordination, and delivering results in an international environment? We are looking for a structured and service-minded Spare Parts Coordinator to join our Customer Service team. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the efficient handling of spare parts inquiries, quotations, and sales orders, contributing to an excellent customer experience through professional support, proactive communication, and reliable order execution.

As a Spare Parts Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the spare parts process from initial customer inquiry through to final delivery. You will handle spare parts requests, prepare quotations, process sales orders, and proactively follow up with customers regarding availability, lead times, and order status. Working closely with procurement, planning, logistics, warehouse operations, and other internal stakeholders, you will help ensure smooth and timely order fulfillment while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

To succeed in this role, you have experience within customer service, order processing, spare parts sales, logistics, or a similar operational function. You are comfortable working with ERP systems and digital tools and ideally have the ability to understand and work with technical product information. Strong communication skills in both Danish and English are important, as you will interact with customers and colleagues across different functions and locations.

As a person, you are service-oriented, structured, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and attention to detail. You are able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment while maintaining a high level of quality and professionalism. You enjoy working collaboratively across departments, are solution-oriented in your approach, and take pride in delivering excellent service to both customers and colleagues.

We offer an exciting and varied position in a growing international company where you will become part of a dedicated and professional team. You will have the opportunity to work closely with customers and colleagues across the organization while contributing to continuous improvements, operational excellence, and the company's ongoing growth and success.

Why Should You Join Körber Supply Chain DK?

We offer an exciting role in an international company in growth, where you will work with advanced technical solutions and be part of a strong professional environment characterized by collaboration and dedication. We offer a range of attractive employee benefits:

Security & Health: In addition to a competitive salary package, you will be enrolled in our mandatory pension scheme, which also includes both health insurance and dental insurance, as well as access to physiotherapy. You will also be part of our lunch program, where our canteen provides healthy and exciting meals every day.

Development: We continuously offer training and courses, as we believe that our success is built on satisfied and skilled employees. That’s why we focus on both personal and professional development to ensure continuous growth.

Social Events: We have a strong company culture that we invest heavily in maintaining and developing. This includes a wide range of events and an active employee association that organizes activities such as Friday bars, Christmas parties, an annual ski trip, cultural events, and much more!

Körber – Conquer Supply Chain Complexity

We value diversity and welcome all applicants, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, identity, or any other protected status.

Apply now:

If you would like to create your future as a part of the Körber Supply Chain DK A/S team, please forward your application and CV already today!

Applications for this position have no deadline, as we will include candidates in the recruitment process on a continuous basis and will close the process once we have found the right candidate.

**Our Tech Stack: https://stackshare.io/companies/sedna

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own charge point management for public CPOs on the Spirii platform. You will own the product area end-to-end and work across multiple teams, from charger connectivity and protocols to monitoring and device capabilities. You will shape the strategy, build the commercial case for it, and help drive its impact on revenue, margin and retention.

The Role

As Product Manager for Public CPOs, you will work closely with engineering, design and commercial teams to solve meaningful customer problems in ways that deliver business impact. You will shape the product vision, own an outcome-focused roadmap, and lead discovery based on evidence. You will also share your knowledge with other Product Managers and help build a strong, data-driven product culture across the organisation.

What You Will Do

• 
Vision & Strategy: Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for charge point management, and decide which problems are worth solving and which are not.

• 
Outcome-Focused Roadmapping: Prioritise initiatives based on customer value, business impact and feasibility.

• 
Discovery & Validation: Lead continuous discovery with customers, design and engineering. Test ideas early and use evidence, not assumptions, to make decisions.

• 
Commercial & Go-to-Market: Build business cases that tie your product area to ARR, gross margin and retention. Work with Sales, Marketing and Operations on pricing, packaging and go-to-market for charge point capabilities.

• 
Standards & Regulation: Follow standards and regulatory changes (OCPP 2.0.1/2.1, OCPI 2.3, AFIR) and turn them into roadmap decisions.

• 
Partnerships: Help shape integrations and partnerships with third-party hardware manufacturers for compatibility, scale and long-term flexibility.

• 
Delivery & Product Craft: Help your teams ship predictably, and write clear strategy docs, PRDs and customer communication.

• 
AI & Agentic Tools: Use agentic tools in your daily work, and share prompts, skills or workflows with other PMs.

• 
Stakeholder Communication: Communicate context, trade-offs and results clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership, and use data to align priorities when they conflict.

• 
Knowledge Sharing: Support other Product Managers, share what you learn, and contribute to a collaborative product culture.

Qualifications

• 
5+ years in product management, ideally in EV charging, energy, IoT or B2B SaaS platforms, or equivalent domain depth.

• 
Experience owning a product or product area end-to-end, ideally across more than one team, with measurable results.

• 
Strong technical grounding in APIs, platforms and integrations. OCPP experience is a strong plus.

• 
Experience building business cases, and ideally working on pricing and packaging with commercial teams.

• 
Ability to influence across functions and seniority levels, including saying no with data.

• 
Hands-on experience with AI and agentic tools in your daily product work.

• 
Experience defining and tracking product metrics with tools like Mixpanel, Metabase, PowerBI or Datadog.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• 
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• 
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• 
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• 
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• 
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• 
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.

• 
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

• 
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-mobility provider which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Nevertheless, the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

The Opportunity

Mercura is looking for an experienced Sales Director to build and grow our partner channel across Europe, with an initial focus on the German-speaking markets. This is a key commercial role for a sales professional who knows the B2B software industry, understands how indirect sales work, and already has a strong network of potential partners.

You will play a central role in expanding Mercura's reach through established software partners such as VARs and other solution providers selling ERP, CRM, PIM, CAD and similar B2B software. The ideal candidate combines a proven sales track record with genuine industry relationships and the ability to turn those relationships into productive, long-term partnerships.

Your Responsibilities

• Identify, approach and recruit new partners.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with VARs, software resellers, solution providers and other relevant channel partners.

• Use your existing industry network to create qualified opportunities and accelerate market entry.

• Develop partner plans and go-to-market strategies that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.

• Own the partner sales cycle from initial engagement and qualification through agreement, activation and ongoing development and training.

• Work closely with Mercura's sales, marketing and implementation teams to enable partners and maximise joint opportunities.

• Develop partner relationships into sustainable, high-value sales channels rather than one-off referrals.

• Track partner performance, pipeline and revenue, and continuously identify opportunities for growth.

What We Are Looking For

• Proven B2B software sales experience with a strong track record of achieving commercial targets.

• Several years of experience in the software industry, ideally in partner sales, channel sales, indirect sales or a closely related role.

• An established network of relevant software partners, particularly in the German-speaking markets.

• Existing relationships with VARs or other organisations selling ERP, CRM, PIM, CAD or similar B2B software solutions.

• Strong business development and relationship-building skills, with the ability to open doors and build trust at senior level.

• A commercially driven, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently in a growing company.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

• Fluent German and English, both written and spoken, is essential.

What We Offer

• A key position with direct influence on Mercura's growth and partner strategy.

• The opportunity to build and own a partner channel in important European markets.

• A young, ambitious team and a growing company with a clear competitive edge.

• A role with significant autonomy, responsibility and room to make an impact.

• A collaborative environment where your industry experience and network will be highly valued.

• Competitive terms and the opportunity to grow with the company.

The Profile

You are a hands-on sales professional who knows the software market, has a strong network and enjoys creating business through relationships. You are comfortable opening doors, engaging senior decision-makers and turning promising conversations into commercial partnerships. You bring energy, credibility and a track record of results, and you want to play a visible role in building the next stage of a growing software company.

We’re looking for a Swedish Account Executive/Manager to join our team. We’re seeing strong momentum in demand for our eID (electronic identity) solutions, and there’s a big opportunity to help organizations integrate secure logins and digital signatures using eIDs.

About Idura

We help organizations securely verify users and support digital signing through eID integrations. As an official MitID broker in Denmark, we also support additional European eIDs, including BankID, FTN, and more. Our solutions are KYC-compliant, user-friendly, and aligned with standards such as PAdES and eIDAS.

In September 2024, Idura was acquired by Stø (formerly BankID BankAxept), strengthening Stø’s position in European digital identity. Stø is owned by the banks in Norway through the company Vipps Holding AS.

About the role

• 
Employment: Full-time.

• 
Location: Copenhagen office (or remote from Sweden)

• 
You’ll manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualifying to presenting solutions, negotiating, and closing.

• 
Expect a mix of inbound and outbound leads, plus upselling to existing customers.

• 
You’ll work closely with Marketing, Product, and Technical teams to support onboarding, implementation, and customer success.

• 
You’ll maintain your pipeline and reporting in HubSpot CRM.

You’ll report to VP Sales Lars Mørch and be part of an international sales team.

What you’ll bring

• 
3+ years of proven B2B sales experience, ideally in SaaS, cybersecurity, or identity management.

• 
Strong pipeline-building, solution-selling, and closing skills.

• 
The ability to explain technical topics clearly, including authentication, digital signatures, APIs, and integrations.

• 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across business and technical teams.

• 
Fluency in Swedish and strong English skills.

• 
CRM proficiency (HubSpot/Salesforce) and a structured approach to forecasting and reporting.

• 
Experience in regulated or KYC-focused environments is a bonus.

Application process

We’ll review applications throughout November and begin interviews in early December.

Application deadline: November 30.

For more information or questions please contact us at albert@thehub.io

Idura is a Copenhagen-based company specializing in secure user authentication and digital signature solutions using electronic identities (eIDs). We empower companies to integrate eIDs into websites or applications effortlessly, ensuring an efficient, secure login or signature process at a cost-effective price. As an official MitID broker in Denmark, we offer MitID as well as a range of European eIDs, including BankID in Sweden and Norway, Finnish Trust Network (FTN) and itsme in Belgium. Our mission is to ensure the highest level of security in digital verification, making the digital world a safer place to roam. Authentication We provide a fast and simple integration of eIDs for businesses that want to verify their customers on their website or app. Our solution allows your users to authenticate themselves with secure and KYC compliant eIDs, which provides the most secure and user-friendly login experience possible. Digital signatures Implement digital signatures into your workflow and sign PDF documents digitally with eIDs. We ensure that all of our digital signatures are secure and compliant with PAdES and eIDAS.

ABOUT THE JOB

Flatpay is on a mission to simplify payments for small and medium-sized businesses. We provide transparent, low-cost payment solutions combined with fast onboarding and real human support - fair pricing, great technology, and local support that merchants can rely on. One of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest-ever unicorn, we've scaled to 2,500+ colleagues across multiple markets, and we're just getting started. Pay is our terminal-only product: a card terminal, flat transparent pricing, and nothing the merchant has to configure. It is the product most of our merchants gets first, it carries the majority of our processing volume, and it is the product we lead with in every new market. This is a deliberately commercial product leadership role. Flatpay's whole model rests on a single visit: a rep walks into a bakery, a salon or a bike shop unannounced, explains flat, transparent pricing, demos the terminal, installs it and trains the staff. Everything Pay does exists to make that visit convert and to keep the merchant on the terminal afterwards. If you've only ever led product through a research team and a dashboard, this won't be the role for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own Pay end to end

• 
Own the Pay product globally - terminal hardware, the payment experience, onboarding and activation, the merchant app, settlement and reporting. One roadmap, all markets.

• 
Set the Pay strategy and defend it: what we build, what we deliberately do not build, and what stays the same across every market so the product does not fragment as we add countries.

• 
Keep the product radically simple. Our merchants are not technical and have no IT function; simplicity is the product, and protecting it is your job before it is anyone else's.

Lead the team

• 
Lead and grow the Pay product team (three PMs today, with the reporting track dotted in), setting the bar for discovery, delivery and written thinking.

• 
Be a player-coach. You'll run your own track on the hardest problems, not only review other people's.

• 
Partner with Engineering, Design and Data in Copenhagen to turn the Pay roadmap into shipped product on roughly two-month cycles, MVP mindset - get it live, learn, iterate.

The field

• 
Get out into the field. Sit with merchants, ride along with sales, spend time with support, and turn what you hear into product decisions. We expect this of a Head of Pay as much as of a PM.

• 
Partner with Sales, Support and Marketing across markets to surface what is actually happening with merchants, and feed it straight into the roadmap.

• 
Build and hold the competitive view for Pay: how competitors package and price terminal and Pay-only offers in Europe and the US, and where they are beatable.

Markets and expansion

• 
Make Pay launch-ready for each new market - acquiring setup, local payment behaviour, regulation, hardware logistics - and work with the US team in New York on what the US needs from the European product.

• 
Own outcome metrics for Pay: activation, processing volume, retention, churn, support load, and the commercial metrics above.

WHO YOU ARE

• 
3+ years in product, with experience leading product managers - and still extremely hands-on.

• 
A commercial, results-driven mindset. You think in merchants, conversion, volume and margin, and you can point to a pricing or product decision you made that moved one of them.

• 
Evidence of field-driven discovery: a decision you can name that came directly from time in front of merchants or sales, not from a research readout.

• 
A track record of shipping fast in a low-structure environment, and comfort building the structure as you go rather than waiting for it.

• 
A generalist and builder who thrives in a fast-paced scale-up and is happy working outside their comfort zone.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management across functions, markets and time zones, and excellent written and spoken English.

AI IS PART OF THE JOB

• 
Flatpay's cost advantage comes from doing things with fewer people than the incumbents. AI is how we keep that true as we add markets, and we expect a Head of Pay to treat it as part of the product, not as a side project.

• 
Use it yourself, daily. You prototype with it, you write specs and analysis with it, you run your own competitive and pricing research with it. You'll be setting the bar for three PMs, and the bar is that a PM who cannot get a working prototype or a data answer in an afternoon is slower than the role now requires.

• 
Know where it does not belong. Nothing in the authorisation path, nothing the merchant has to supervise, nothing that makes a terminal less predictable. Our merchants are not technical and have no IT function.

• 
Be honest about the economics. Inference cost, error rate and the cost of being wrong are product decisions. You should be able to argue why a model belongs in a flow at our volumes, or why a rule set is the better answer.

WHY FLATPAY?

As part of our team, you will join +2000 passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments in Europe. Flatpay is proud to be a company that values diversity. We ensure an inclusive work environment for all our employees and offer opportunities for professional growth and development. We have free slushice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and plenty of other fun things at our office! If you are ready to be part of this exciting journey, we would love to hear from you today.

That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors.  What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? WHAT's THE CULTURE LIKE? Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, but we also set clear expectations and hold ourselves accountable to results.  As a growing business, things move quickly. That means you’ll have the opportunity to take on real responsibility early, contribute ideas, and see the impact of your work directly. It also means being comfortable with change, solving problems as they arise, and continuously improving how we operate.  We’re best suited to people who are motivated by challenge, enjoy working towards clear goals, and want to develop in a commercial, high-energy environment. WHY CHOOSE FLATPAY? Flatpay offers the opportunity to take real ownership, develop valuable skills, and grow your career in a fast-moving, ambitious company where performance and initiative are recognised.

Retire the ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

Finance deserves better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

• 
Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

• 
Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

• 
Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We're looking for a Nordics Marketing Manager to make Light the default finance platform for scaling companies across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. You can base yourself in Copenhagen or London.

Light started life in Copenhagen, and the Nordics already know us. Founders, CFOs and finance leaders in the region backed us from the start, and our local community gives us a head start most challengers would envy. Your job is to take that energy to new heights, so that when a Nordic finance team outgrows its current setup, Light is the obvious next move.

You'll own the Nordics marketing plan end to end. You'll have a B-line into our Nordics GTM pod, which spans sales, implementation and customer success, and you'll work closely with our central growth team to find new ways to drive demand through digital channels.

What you'll be doing

• 
Building and running the Nordics marketing plan, with pipeline targets you share with the GTM pod.

• 
Running a field and events programme across Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo and Helsinki and… any other city you think makes sense. From intimate CFO dinners to flagship moments people talk about for months.

• 
Growing partnerships with the accounting firms, advisors, investors and communities that Nordic finance leaders trust and extends our voice across the region.

• 
Localising our story, content and campaigns so they land with Nordic finance teams in their own language and context.

• 
Creating content with our customers, product and design teams that turns what Light does into stories people want to share.

• 
Working with our central growth team to test and scale digital demand generation in the region.

• 
Building relationships with local press and the people who shape the Nordic tech and finance conversation.

What we think* you'll need

• 
Enough years in the seat to know what works at a fast-growing company, ideally because you've built the ground game for a scaling B2B SaaS business before.

• 
A track record across field, events, partnerships and content, and the judgment to know which lever to pull and when.

• 
Experience localising a brand and its message for a region, with a feel for what lands with Nordic audiences.

• 
Comfort working with sales, implementation and customer success as one team, with pipeline as the shared goal.

• 
Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping finance teams and the companies they serve.

• 
A great storyteller across video, text and meme.

• 
A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant assholes here, please.

• 
Fluency in English and at least one other Nordic language.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Positions in Experimental Nanophotonics and Quantum Optics
jobs.description:
The research group of Professor Maiken H. Mikkelsen at the Niels Bohr Institute (NBI), University of Copenhagen, invites applications for two Postdoctoral Researcher positions in experimental nanophotonics and quantum optics.

  Professor Mikkelsen’s group studies how light and matter interact when light is confined to nanometre-scale volumes. Using plasmonic nanocavities — metallic nanogaps fabricated deterministically around a chosen emitter — the group reaches a regime far beyond the reach of conventional optical cavities: Purcell factors above 10,000, single-photon emission at telecom wavelengths with lifetimes of tens of picoseconds at room temperature, and second-harmonic generation enhanced more than ten-million-fold in materials with no bulk nonlinearity. In this regime, light–matter behaviour appears that was not previously thought possible, and the group’s experiments are increasingly directed at the nonlinear and ultrafast optics it opens up. Experiments combine nanofabrication, single-photon and photon-correlation spectroscopy, cryogenic magneto-optics and ultrafast pump–probe optics. The group has recently relocated from Duke University to NBI, supported by a DKK 35 million RECRUIT award from the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and is establishing a laboratory in NBI’s new building. Postdocs joining now will help build the laboratory and shape its first experiments. Recent work: https://mikkelsenphotonics.com.

  The positions span three axes of control over light–matter interaction; the balance between them will depend on the candidates:

  Spatial structure — shaping the vacuum around an emitter and concentrating the field for nonlinear optics, with examples including Purcell tensors, the nanophotonic Lamb shift, harmonic generation in nanoscale volumes, and forbidden and two-photon transitions opened by field gradients.

  Emitter number — cavity QED with exactly one, two or several emitters, including the crossover from room-temperature to cryogenic strong coupling, collective emission, and multi-exciton emission that outruns Auger recombination.

  Temporal control — ultrafast and time-resolved experiments on single nanocavities, including single-nanocavity pump–probe spectroscopy, optically dressed states in quantum materials embedded in nanogaps, and time-varying cavities.

  We seek outstanding, creative, and highly motivated experimentalists with a PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, electrical engineering, or a closely related discipline, and a strong background in one or more of: nanophotonics or cavity QED; quantum optics and photon-correlation measurements; cryogenic spectroscopy of solid-state emitters or two-dimensional materials; ultrafast optical spectroscopy; nanofabrication. Candidates are encouraged to propose directions of their own within this scope; the programme will be shaped by the people who join.

  The successful candidates will carry out experimental research, help set up the new laboratory, including a 1.7 K cryostat with a vector magnet, a tunable femtosecond laser system and single-photon confocal spectroscopy, publish and present results, and participate in the supervision of students. The positions may also include collaboration with national and international research partners and other academic duties as required. The group fabricates its cavities in the NBI cleanroom and at DTU Nanolab, Denmark's national nanofabrication centre.

   

  Further information on the Department at https://nbi.ku.dk/english/. Informal inquiries are welcome and can be made to Professor Maiken H. Mikkelsen, maiken.mikkelsen@nbi.ku.dk.

  The positions are for three years, starting as soon as possible, with flexible start dates into 2027.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. 

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. 

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. 

  When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

  Please include 

   	
• Cover letter describing your motivation and research interests (max 1 page) 	
• Curriculum vitae, including publication list 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD degree, or documentation of expected PhD completion date) 	
• Names and contact details of two or three references   The deadline for applications is 1 December 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. 

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews are not yet scheduled.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor (fixed-term) in Experimental Nanophotonics and Quantum Optics
jobs.description:
The Niels Bohr Institute (NBI), University of Copenhagen, invites applications for a fixed-term Assistant Professor position in experimental nanophotonics and quantum optics, in the group of Professor Maiken H. Mikkelsen. The position is for four years, open from as soon as possible; a later start in 2027 can be negotiated.

Professor Mikkelsen's group studies how light and matter interact when light is confined to nanometre-scale volumes. Using plasmonic nanocavities — metallic nanogaps fabricated deterministically around a chosen emitter — the group reaches a regime far beyond the reach of conventional optical cavities: Purcell factors above 10,000, single-photon emission at telecom wavelengths with lifetimes of tens of picoseconds at room temperature, and second-harmonic generation enhanced more than ten-million-fold in materials with no bulk second-order nonlinearity. In this regime, light–matter behaviour appears that was not previously thought possible, and the group's experiments are increasingly directed at the nonlinear and ultrafast optics it opens up. Experiments combine nanofabrication, single-photon and photon-correlation spectroscopy, cryogenic magneto-optics and ultrafast pump–probe optics. The group has recently relocated from Duke University to NBI, supported by a DKK 35 million RECRUIT award from the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and is establishing a laboratory in NBI's new building. Recent work: https://mikkelsenphotonics.com.

The Assistant Professor will lead an independent research direction within the group’s programme on light–matter interaction in nanocavities. Directions of particular interest include:

• 
Cavity QED with few emitters — strong coupling with exactly one, two or several quantum emitters in deterministically fabricated nanogaps, the crossover from room-temperature to cryogenic strong coupling, collective emission, and quantum light generation from nanocavity-coupled emitters

• 
Quantum and two-dimensional materials in nanogaps — out-of-plane excitations (interlayer excitons, dark excitons, trions) coupled to the vertical field of a nanogap at cryogenic temperatures and in vector magnetic fields; optically dressed states of 2D semiconductors and magnets driven inside a nanogap and read out by single-cavity ultrafast spectroscopy

• 
Ultrafast and nonlinear nanophotonics — time-resolved experiments on single nanocavities, including single-nanocavity pump–probe spectroscopy, harmonic generation in nanoscale volumes, time-varying cavities, and forbidden and two-photon transitions opened by field gradients

 Candidates are expected to define their own experimental programme within this scope, and proposals that cut across these directions are welcome.

This is a leadership position for an early-career scientist ready for independence. The Assistant Professor will be the senior scientist in the group alongside Professor Mikkelsen, with day-to-day responsibility for one research direction and its students. The successful candidate will take scientific ownership of the group's new cryogenic and ultrafast facilities, including a 1.7 K cryostat with a vector magnet and a tunable femtosecond laser system, co-supervise PhD and master's students, and develop their own funding portfolio, with active support from the group and the institute. They will be supported in applying as principal investigator for Danish and European early-career grants, and the position includes a dedicated budget line for a student and consumables. The group fabricates its cavities in the NBI cleanroom and at DTU Nanolab, Denmark's national nanofabrication centre.

We seek an outstanding experimentalist, typically three to seven years after the PhD, with a strong publication record, demonstrated independence, and hands-on expertise in several of: nanophotonics, cavity QED or plasmonics; quantum optics and photon-correlation measurements; cryogenic optical and magneto-optical spectroscopy; ultrafast pump–probe spectroscopy; nanofabrication. Expertise in the exfoliation, transfer, assembly and encapsulation of van der Waals heterostructures, including gated devices, is an asset. Experience supervising students and an interest in teaching are expected. The group is simultaneously recruiting postdoctoral researchers; candidates may apply to both positions.

The position is a fixed-term appointment of four years, funded by external research grants, and is not tenure-track. The objective is that the successful candidate concludes the appointment with an established research direction, an independent funding record, and a strong case for a permanent position at the University of Copenhagen or elsewhere.

The assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regard to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within quantum optics and photonics. To a limited extent this may also include performance of other duties. 

Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

General criteria apply to the appointment of Assistant Professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

**Overview

**The Senior Manager, Clinical Trial Planning is an individual contributor focused on supporting Clinical Trial Teams (CTTs) in the effective management of clinical trial timelines across the portfolio. The role drives planning system enablement (Planisware), owns and maintains a standardized Microsoft Project (MSP) trial planning template, and develops high-quality timeline visualizations to support trial execution and governance decision-making.

The role partners closely with Global Trial Leaders (GTLs), who are accountable for the overall delivery of their trials and retain ownership of trial timelines within internal planning systems. The Clinical Trial Planner complements this accountability by ensuring planning data is structured, standardized, and translated into clear, actionable insights that enable effective execution and decision-making.

**Responsibilities/tasks

****Planisware Enablement & Trial Support

**

• Partner with GTLs across the portfolio to drive effective use of Planisware and ensure trial plans reflect agreed assumptions, dependencies, and execution strategy, while GTLs retain overall accountability.

• Liaise with Development Program Managers (DPMs) to align trial-level plans with program- and asset-level timelines and milestones.

• Collaborate with the Portfolio Planning team to provide structured trial-level insights and recommendations that inform ongoing refinement and maintenance of Planisware templates and standards.

**MS Project (MSP) Template Ownership & Standardization

**

• Develop and maintain a fit for purpose Microsoft Project (MSP) Trial Planning template for GTL use across study phases.

• Ensure alignment between the MSP template, Planisware, and portfolio-level planning standards.

• Provide guidance to GTLs to promote consistent, high-quality timeline development using the MSP template.

**Data Visualization

**

• Develop and deliver clear visualization templates derived from Planisware and/or MSP data, displaying key milestones and activities.

• Tailor visual outputs to support CTTs, governance, and leadership discussions.

**Process & Tool Adoption

**

• Act as a Planisware subject matter expert at the trial-support level.

• Reinforce GTL training through hands-on guidance and real-time coaching.

• Apply and promote standardized planning methodologies and visualization standards across the portfolio.

**Governance Awareness & Decision Support

**

• Prepare timeline views and supporting materials aligned with governance forum expectations (e.g., Project Board, Portfolio Board, Operational Review Committee).

• Anticipate governance triggers based on timeline changes or emerging risks.

• Translate planning data into concise, decision-ready visuals and summaries.

**Requirements/Preferences

****Senior Manager

**

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• Approximately 7-10+ years of experience in clinical trial operations, project management, trial planning, or related roles.

• Demonstrated experience driving planning system adoption and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.

• Experience developing or standardizing planning templates, tools, or reporting frameworks across multiple studies.

• Strong understanding of portfolio-level planning considerations and governance expectations.

• Advanced analytical capability and ability to provide structured execution insight to leadership forums.

jobs.description:
MEDARBEJDERE SØGES TIL ARBEJDE PÅ JERNBANEN

Vi vækster så vi ikke kan følge med, så har du lyst til at arbejde udendørs og blive en del af et stærkt team? 

Vi søger nemlig medarbejdere til buskrydning dag/nat, samt kabelvagter nat, med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Om jobbet

Arbejdet som buskrydder består af, beskæring af grønne arealer langs jernbanen. Erfaring med buskbeskæring er ikke et krav, men vi forventer, at du kan håndtere værktøj på en forsvarlig og sikker måde.

Arbejdet som kabelvagt består af, markering af drift kabler langs jernbanen. Dette er som udgangspunkt natarbejde. Erfaring er ikke et krav, men der bliver gået mange km på flere slags underlag, herunder skaver mm.  

- Vi har base i Korsør, men arbejdet foregår på hele Sjælland

- Som udgangspunkt 37 timer om ugen.

- Weekend- og overarbejde kan forekomme

Vi forventer, at du:

- Er mødestabil

- Er ansvarsbevidst

- Har gå på mod

- Har lyst til at lære nyt

Krav:

- Kørekort til bil. 

- Over 18 år

Derudover:

“Pas på banen”-kursus er et krav, så det er en kæmpe fordel hvis du allerede har det. Men hvis du ikke har det, sørger vi for at du får det. 

Vi tilbyder:

- Hurtig opstart

- Gode kollegaer og den rette oplæring

- Løn efter kvalifikationer

Send din ansøgning til Kundeservice@estotalbyg.dk og skriv gerne hvilken stilling du søger.
